scope: Fresh full Python regression with independent actual child exit and source identity capture; no native or behavior change.

preserved_incomplete_attempt.credit: None; summary alone does not establish child exit.

guards.owned_process_group: Record UID, PID, SID and start time; terminate only that group on timeout or external signal.

capture.launch: Record source HEAD, expectation Git blob, controller and independent child wrapper hashes, Python actual executable hash, source manifest, process identity and absolute deadline before execution.
capture.independent_child: A dedicated wrapper records actual pytest return code and timeout or signal disposition immediately after wait, before slow source hashing.
capture.controller: Record its terminal code separately; detached launch returns only launch acknowledgement.
capture.source_integrity: Before and after hashes for all tracked and nonignored untracked regular files; source HEAD unchanged.
capture.artifact_integrity: Pin log, launch, independent child result and source manifests.

acceptance: Actual child wrapper and outer controller exit zero.
No frozen guard breach or external termination.
Pytest terminal summary has zero failed and zero error cases.
Source byte manifest and HEAD unchanged.
Independent child result agrees with outer capture.
non_acceptance: No credit from prior positive log summary without actual exit.
No interpretation of an absent terminal as success.
No changed tests, selections, skip policy, clock, native behavior or source after launch.
next_step: Publish the reviewed native correction only after this gate and the existing lint, native and independent review gates pass.
